path.description: Image file path, absolute or relative to the current project root.

max_dimension.description: Maximum preview side in pixels, preserving aspect ratio; small images are never enlarged. Raise this for fine details.

quality.description: Initial JPEG quality for opaque images; lowered to at most 70 then 60 before reducing dimensions. Transparent images preserve alpha as lossless WebP.

target_bytes.description: Desired maximum encoded preview bytes. Increase to preserve more detail; dimensions shrink further if encoding alone cannot fit. An impossible target fails explicitly.
